context: A boss reviews a CSR/policy strategy
purpose: Teach: 酵素/混同/判る/落ち着か/投下/党員/政界/接待

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の酵素事業、政界の動向も注視しろ。
lines.en: Our enzyme division—watch the political landscape carefully. It matters.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Leans slightly forward on the opening. Each clause deliberately paced. No rush. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の混同、判るような広告を打っています。
lines.en: Yes. We're running ads to clarify the public confusion on the science.
lines.style: Steady, competent. Direct eye contact maintained. Matter-of-fact recitation of work already in motion. Slight lift at the end—reporting completion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 落ち着かない世論、地道なPRを投下しろ。
lines.en: Public sentiment is unsettled. Deploy sustained, careful PR work. Not flash.
lines.style: Lean, instructive. Emphasis on 'sustained'—the word carries the weight of strategy. Slow cadence. Not lecturing, directing. Expectation of understanding underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 党員候補へのレクチャー、別途設定しました。
lines.en: I've already set up separate training sessions for the party candidates.
lines.style: Efficient, slightly anticipatory—pre-empting approval. Quick, businesslike delivery. Small nod on 'separately.' The tone of a junior who's thought one step ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Entertainment is absolutely off-limits. None of it.
lines.style: Sharp, final. Crisp attack on the first word. No warmth here—this is the line that doesn't move. Brief pause after the period in his mind, though none in speech. The sound of policy.
